action: const Koa = require('koa'); const Router = require('koa-router'); const bodyParser = require('koa-bodyparser'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const app = new Koa(); const router = new Router(); const logFilePath = path.join(__dirname, 'logs.txt'); // Middleware to parse JSON body app.use(bodyParser()); // Route to log a message router.post('/log', async (ctx) => { const { message } = ctx.request.body; if (!message || typeof message !== 'string') { ctx.status = 400; ctx.body = { error: 'Invalid message' }; return; } // Append the log message to the file asynchronously fs.appendFile(logFilePath, message + '\n', 'utf8', (err) => { if (err) { ctx.status = 500; ctx.body = { error: 'Failed to log message' }; return; } ctx.status = 200; ctx.body = { message: 'Log message successful' }; }); }); // Route to retrieve logs router.get('/logs', async (ctx) => { if (fs.existsSync(logFilePath)) { const logs = fs.readFileSync(logFilePath, 'utf8'); ctx.status = 200; ctx.body = logs; } else { ctx.status = 200; ctx.body = 'No logs found'; } }); // Use the router app.use(router.routes()).use(router.allowedMethods()); // Start the server const PORT = 5000; app.listen(PORT, () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });
